data.title: About Kajal
bio: Kajal Shah has lived in NJ since 2001.  Kajal is married to Dr.  Nilesh Shah, who is also her real estate team partner in TheTeamShah, and they have 3 children Naman (31), Navan (25) and Giya (16).  Kajal has been working as a realtor with her clients with their real estate needs since 2014.  Kajal got her Broker’s license in 2021.

Kajal speaks many languages fluently, but her favorite language is real estate!  Kajal’s passion is to provide her clients with professional, exceptional service thereby building strong, lasting relationships.  Kajal relies on her intuitiveness and her patience to help.  Home buyers and sellers have a positive, engaging experience.  Delivering extraordinary customer service has always been a part of Kajal’s wheelhouse.

As a fashion designer in India, as a small business owner of a bread company, as a teacher at a childcare center and as a representative in a bank, Kajal has a knack for taking care of people’s needs and making sure they have the best experience possible.  When it comes to your real estate needs, Kajal Cares.  Kajal enjoys traveling, dancing, singing, sewing, photography, decorating, watching movies and TV shows, in her free time.  She is fluent in English, Punjabi, and Hindi.
